_what: The billed meters, ported one to one from old trillion src/usage-meters.json (Trillion-X/trillion b92aa549, `meters` at :17-80 and `resource_pricing` at :81-104, copied unchanged). Prices, margin and plans stay here and in the seller's usage-pricing-rule rows, never in the engine. `live_readings` names, for each meter's `reading`, the field of the account's own usage day row the engine writes (trillion-rust src/namespace/usage.rs, read by the files door operation usage_days) and how many of that field make one settled unit; do-work/live-usage.mjs reads them.

live_readings._what: reading -> {row_field, unit, per_unit, level}. A level (stored-bytes) is a byte count kept that day, settled as byte-days over per_unit (a gigabyte-day); an amount (work, source bytes) is what was used that day. The engine's work count is milliseconds of tool run time; the old work-cost reading was priced store rows, so meter:service-work now settles milliseconds against its supplier invoice.

resource_readings._what: Which reading each settled resource counts: a meter row's own `reading`, and resource:source-bytes (a resource_pricing row with no meter row in the old file) the source-bytes reading.
